title: Switch warm red theme tokens to calm green palette

requirements.summary: Replace warm/red-leaning background and accents with a calm green palette while preserving all existing content and layout.
acceptanceCriteria: Primary brand color (buttons, links, highlights) renders as a calm green instead of coral/red.
Page background and gradient hero backgrounds no longer appear warm red/pink; they should read as neutral + calm green accents.
Muted section backgrounds (e.g., Section variant="muted") remain subtle and readable with the updated palette.
No changes to marketing copy, routing, or component structure; only styling/theme values change.

file_operations.description: Update the light/dark CSS theme token values so any UI using Tailwind theme colors (e.g., bg-background, text-primary, from-primary/to-accent gradients, borders, and hover states) reads as neutral + calm green accents rather than warm coral/orange. Keep all markup and layout unchanged.

Adjust any warm-tinted Tailwind theme extensions (notably the custom boxShadow value currently named "warm") to a green-compatible, subtle brand glow to prevent residual warm/orange casts while preserving existing class usage.

requirements.summary: Implement calm green palette by updating Tailwind OKLCH theme tokens (light/dark) including background, primary, secondary, accent, ring, and warm-biased chart/shadow tokens.
acceptanceCriteria: frontend/src/index.css updates the :root and .dark token set so --primary/--accent/--ring (and any other warm-biased tokens) are green-toned.
Interactive focus rings and outlines (ring utilities) visually match the new calm green theme.
Any existing warm-themed shadow token(s) (e.g., warm glow) are updated to a green-compatible equivalent or removed if unused, with no visual regressions (no harsh/oversaturated green casts).

file_operations.description: Replace warm-biased OKLCH variables in :root and .dark with calm green-toned values: update --primary, --secondary, --accent, and --ring to green hues; neutralize background/surface tokens away from red/pink warmth; and shift --chart-1..--chart-5 away from warm oranges/yellows toward a green-friendly set while maintaining contrast and readability.

Update Tailwind theme extensions that encode warm coloring (e.g., the "warm" boxShadow definition) to a calm green-tinted equivalent, or remove/neutralize if unused, ensuring focus/hover visuals remain consistent with the new green ring/primary tokens.
